name: audit-eval-harness-trace-retrieval
title: Fix the eval recipe's trace-evidence loss
description: Audit A-066: eval mode 404s the /v1/debug command-trace export and the in-memory ring dies with the process, so an eval recipe run without --persist-command-db/--persist-command-log loses all agent-activity evidence after shutdown. Add the persistence flag to the README eval recipe, emit a wall-safe serve_main startup warning when eval mode runs without persistence, document the retrieval path in SECURITY.md, and flip ledger A-066 to fixed.
creator: sdelmas
